# Fuzhou Fuqiang Precision Co., Ltd.

> Chinese manufacturer specializing in battery pack sealing, thermal management systems, and EV battery protection with aerogel and silicone foam materials.

Fuzhou Fuqiang Precision is a precision manufacturing facility located in Dongtai Industrial Park, Minhou County, China, producing high-quality battery thermal management and sealing solutions for electric vehicles. The company holds IATF16949 and ISO 14001 certifications and serves as both a direct manufacturer and supplier.

## Key Topics

- Battery Pack Sealing
- Thermal Management Systems
- EV Battery Protection
- Aerogel Insulation
- Silicone Foam Gaskets
- Thermal Runaway Protection
- Silicone O-Ring Seals
- Battery Thermal Wrap
- IATF16949 Certification
- Compression Pads
- Flame-Retardant Materials
- Manufacturing
- China Factory
- Auto Parts
- Precision Gaskets

## Product Catalog

- [Battery Thermal Management System](https://www.fqbms.com/supplier-4117193-battery-thermal-management-system): Thermal management systems with aerogel felt and compression pads
- [Battery Pack Sealing](https://www.fqbms.com/supplier-4117199-battery-pack-sealing): Battery pack sealing products including silicone foam gaskets for EVs
- [Battery Thermal Runaway Protection](https://www.fqbms.com/supplier-4117194-battery-thermal-runaway-protection): Thermal runaway protection products including mica sheets and aerogel felt
- [EV Battery Thermal Runaway](https://www.fqbms.com/supplier-4117195-ev-battery-thermal-runaway): EV battery thermal runaway insulation materials and aerogel products
- [Battery Thermal Insulation](https://www.fqbms.com/supplier-4117196-battery-thermal-insulation): Battery thermal insulation products including aerogel and foam sheets
- [Battery Thermal Wrap](https://www.fqbms.com/supplier-4117197-battery-thermal-wrap): Battery thermal wrap using EPDM and silicone rubber materials
- [EV Battery Protection](https://www.fqbms.com/supplier-4117198-ev-battery-protection): EV battery protection foam pads meeting GB/T and ASTM standards
- [Rubber Seal Ring](https://www.fqbms.com/supplier-4117201-rubber-seal-ring): Rubber seal rings and silicone foam O-rings for automotive applications
- [Battery Interface](https://www.fqbms.com/supplier-4117202-battery-interface): Battery interface compression pads and thermal gap filler materials
- [Battery Bonding](https://www.fqbms.com/supplier-4117203-battery-bonding): Battery bonding components including rubber gaskets for EV pack assembly
- [Fit Tolerance Limit](https://www.fqbms.com/supplier-4117200-fit-tolerance-limit): Precision rubber gaskets and melamine foam with tight tolerance limits
- [All Products](https://www.fqbms.com/products.html): Main product catalog featuring thermal runaway protection and insulation materials
